digest.component_or_area: code-review criteria routing and threshold configuration
propositions: Correctness and edge-cases criteria lack routing entries in criteria_routing.json and default to 0.95 threshold instead of blocking at 0.54
Edge-cases (n=618) and correctness (n=909) are the two largest un-routed dimensions in code-v3 corpus but their block-impact at 0.54 has never been measured

Correctness and edge-cases must be explicitly routed as blocking criteria at 0.54 threshold because measured impact shows 4.04% and 1.74% of changes respectively, both within the 8.0% operator-accepted friction budget
Concurrency criterion is routed but advisory (blocking_enabled: false) with 1 surviving finding below MIN_N=25 power floor, so it should remain advisory
Replay and calibration tooling must derive blocking criteria set from routing_index() instead of hard-coding to remain synchronized as postures change
